author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Covers the default formats of option httplog, option httpslog and option tcplog. Custom log-format lines, error lines and health check lines stay in the generic schema. Send the logs to the data collector with a log line such as log <collector>:514 local0 info, or through the host's syslog daemon. The accept date has no time zone: the parser reads it with the zone of an RFC 5424 header (add format rfc5424 to the log line) when there is one, otherwise as UTC. HTTP and HTTPS lines go to HTTP, and a request the proxy refused (termination state PR or PT) is marked blocked. TCP lines go to Netflow, with the session end time and the termination state as the end reason. The log names the backend server but not its address, so destination_address stays unset; the frontend, backend, server and timers go to event_metadata, and with option httpslog the TLS server name goes to uri_host. Samples are made up in the formats of the HAProxy 3.0 configuration manual, section 8.2. Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 (140 of 140 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same lines there. Each child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent. No built-in parser claimed these lines.
